data.content_ref: inline:The proposed relation conflates a computational slip with a substantive structural dependence. Naming 'residual subtraction' as a shared mechanism is thin: SRC_003's residual is the answer, whereas SRC_006's error is an attachment of operands, not a variant execution of the same residual procedure. The 'refuted if' clause concedes this by treating 'mis-segmentation' and 'directional inversion' as distinct escape routes, which signals the covering principle is not settled — the target hedges between a reduction claim and a mere shared-arithmetic description, so it does not deliver one substantive relation kind.
